name: national-clinic-hms
description: Hospital Management System for National Clinic, Aurangabad

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hms/shared && concurrently -n server,hms -c red,blue "npm run dev -w @hms/server" "npm run dev -w @hms/web"
scripts.dev:demo: npm run build -w @hms/shared && concurrently -n server,hms -c red,blue "npm run dev:demo -w @hms/server" "npm run dev -w @hms/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run build -w @hms/server && npm run build -w @hms/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run test -w @hms/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hms/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hms/server && npm run typecheck -w @hms/web
